The filesystem token of the live OS/filesystem/architecture axis is this gate's TCB filesystem selector (filesystemWhereItAffectsResolution / filesystemTypeToken). That axis is RESERVED; this member does not quantify over an undefined filesystem set and does not populate TCB identifierEnum tokens as a coverage-domain allowlist. Hostile environment means presented undeclared or alternate libc/framework/cert/font/ICU/tool objects, alternate loaders, and ambient system-class substitutes on a clean machine (file 04 hostile-clean-machine sentence consumed here, not as a fifth live-cell member). This class is platform TCB / system-class hostility. It is not G07 hostile archive/path/loader/TOCTOU of the verified tree and not G14 hostile PATH/loader/system-tool language-runtime substitutions. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Every D-002-platform cell is present. A skipped platform is not a waiver; waiver is platform removal. Windows is not a cell. Rosetta-on-Apple-Silicon is not a macos/x86_64 cell. An undefined filesystem is not a skipped cell. G07 and G14 are not scored. Until independently pinned fixtures exist, this class cannot be executed and cannot be QUALIFIED.
